{{Short description|German mathematician (1930–2017)}}
'''Rudolf Gorenflo''' (31 July 1930 – 20 October 2017)<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.mi.fu-berlin.de/fb/news/ProfGorenfloVerstorben.html |title=Prof. Dr. Rudolf Gorenflo |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017-11-03 |website= |publisher=FU Berlin |access-date=2017-11-07 |language=de}}</ref> was a German [[mathematician]].

==Biography==
Gorenflo was born on July 31, 1930, in [[Friedrichstal]], [[Germany]]. From 1950 to 1956 he attended [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology]] from which he received his diploma in [[mathematics]]. From 1957 to 1961 he became a scientific assistant there and for a year later worked at Standard Electric Lorenz Company. From 1962 to 1970 he worked at the [[Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics]], at [[Garching]] not too far away from [[Munich]]. He was a resident in mathematics at the [[Technical University in Aachen]] in 1970 and a year later became a professor there.<ref name=fracalmo>{{cite web|url= http://www.fracalmo.org/gorenflo/|title=Prof. Dr. Rudolf Gorenflo|publisher= Fractional Calculus Modeling|accessdate=December 11, 2013}}</ref>

In 1972 he was invited as a guest professor to the [[University of Heidelberg]] and only by October 1973 became a full-time professor at the [[Free University of Berlin]]. In 1995 he became a professor at the [[University of Tokyo]] and by October 1998 returned to Free University as [[professor emeritus]]. During his life he collaborated with scientists from [[China]], [[Israel]], [[Italy]], [[Japan]], former [[Soviet Union]], [[United States]] and [[Vietnam]].<ref name=fracalmo/>

==Academic work==
As of 2013, he had published over 250 [[peer-review]]ed articles, one of which has over 1800 citations. His works have appeared in such journals as the [[Journal of Vibration and Control]] and various [[Journal of Physics (disambiguation)|Journal of Physics]] journals.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=VvuoC5EAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&pagesize=100|title=Rudolf Gorenflo|publisher=[[Google Scholar]]|accessdate=August 30, 2020}}</ref>
